title: ScanResult
description: One detection result for one page. Created by the extension when score >= 30 (EX-07), stored by the backend, shown in Activity/Detail.

id.description: Assigned by backend. Extension sends without id.

domain.description: Registrable domain, lowercase, no www. Verdicts apply per domain (PRD §5).

status.description: 30–79 = warning, >= 80 = blocked. 'normal' results are never stored.

signals.description: Every signal that raised the score, highest weight first. Detail shows the top 1–3 (DT-04).

screenshotUrl.description: Deprecated (EX-07 page replica): only on scans made before the extension switched to pageReplicaUrl. Evidence area only, typed input blurred (PRD §10).

pageReplicaUrl.description: Copy of the page's DOM as static HTML (gzip), short-lived URL from GET /scans/{id}; null in lists and when absent. Render with JavaScript off and no network (contracts/api.md, Page replica).

verdict.description: null until a Guardian decides. Only blocked items can get a verdict in MVP.

id.description: Stable machine id. Known ids are listed in detector-interface.md.

layer.description: 1 database, 2 link name, 3 content & forms, 4 reality check (LLM), 5 hoax (phase 2)

weight.description: Points added to the score, e.g. 30 → '+30%'.

label.description: Guardian wording. e.g. en 'Domain age 3 days' / id 'Umur domain 3 hari'

labelSimple.description: Protected (parent) wording, simpler. e.g. en 'This site was made 3 days ago' / id 'Situs ini baru dibuat 3 hari lalu'

evidence.description: Optional. Text signals: text that appears exactly on the page (highlighted by the extension, EX-05). Field signals (asks_*): the field's name/id. Never typed values. See detector-interface.md.

byName.description: Shown as 'Verified scam by [name]' / 'Marked safe by [name]'. 'you' is rendered client-side.

LocalizedText.description: Text in both app languages. Produced by detector/ai (Team AI); the app shows the one matching the user's language (PF-01).
